To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the design elements of websites influence the online shoppers’ attitudes and purchase intention.

(1) the perceived ease of use of a website has a positive effect on the online customer’s attitude toward the website, which in turn affects the customer’s intention to purchase from the website, and (2) the perceived usefulness of the website has a positive direct effect on the customer’s intention.
the perceived ease of use and the perceived usefulness of website design elements are positively related to the purchase intention of the online customers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following question: How do website design features influence the purchase intention and actual purchase behavior of online consumers?
the impact of web design on purchase intention.
the question of how to make the most of the web design in order to maximize the effectiveness of e-commerce.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
web design has a significant impact on consumer behavior.
web design elements are important to online shoppers and can influence their purchase intentions.
this research has contributed to a better understanding of how website design elements can influence the online shopping behavior of consumers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
web design elements influence online customers’ purchase intention through the mediating role of trust, attitude, and subjective norm.
website design elements influence purchase intention by affecting the attitude toward online shopping, perceived control, subjective norm, and purchase intention.
web design elements influence the perceived usefulness, ease of use, and perceived risk of online customers, which further influence the purchase intention.
The main takeaway from our work is that

website design elements should be designed with a focus on the customers’ cognitive and affective responses to the design elements, as well as the customers’ perceptions of the website’s trustworthiness, credibility, and usefulness.
website design elements can influence online shoppers’ purchase behavior through their effects on attitude and subjective norm.
website design elements have a positive effect on online shoppers’ purchase intention.
